description: Retrieves the Trello list associated with a specific Trello action ID, for actions linked to a list.

inputSchema.description: Defines the request parameters for retrieving the list associated with a specific Trello action.

fields.description: Determines which fields to include in the response. Specify 'all' or a comma-separated list of valid field names. Valid fields are: 'closed', 'idBoard', 'name', 'pos', or 'subscribed'.
fields.title: Fields

idAction.description: The ID of the Trello action for which to retrieve the associated list.
idAction.title: Id Action

inputSchema.title: GetActionsListByIdActionRequest

name: get_actions_list_by_id_action

disableAt.description: The threshold at which the feature is disabled.
disableAt.title: Disable At

warnAt.description: The threshold at which a warning is issued.
warnAt.title: Warn At

GetActionsListByIdActionResponse.description:
Defines the response structure for the action that retrieves the list associated with a Trello action.
Returns a TrelloList object with properties such as id, name, closed, pos, idBoard, and subscribed.

id.description: The unique identifier for the list. Format: 24 hexadecimal characters (TrelloID).
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: The unique identifier of the board this list belongs to.
idBoard.title: Id Board

limits.description: Contains limit information for the list.
limits.title: Limits

pos.description: The position of the list on the board.
pos.title: Pos

softLimit.description: The soft limit for cards in the list.
softLimit.title: Soft Limit

subscribed.description: Whether the user is subscribed to the list.
subscribed.title: Subscribed

GetActionsListByIdActionResponse.title: GetActionsListByIdActionResponse

ListLimits.description: Contains limit information for the list.
ListLimits.title: ListLimits
